title.narrative: of targeted farmers, members of community committee, and service providers operational team (disaggregated by sex) that show improved gender mainstreaming knowledge, attitude and practices towards women empowerment in water resource management

description.narrative: of targeted farmers, members of community committee, and service providers operational team (disaggregated by sex) that show improved gender mainstreaming knowledge, attitude and practices towards women empowerment in water resource management

comment.narrative: Fully met 247 farmers 120 M 127 F showed improvement by 88.23 In March 2022 Oxfam hired external consultant to conduct training on mainstreaming gender in water resource management RTWWR and climate change with the committee members. 240 participants Female and Male from the community committees AlFukhari East Khan Younis and 7 Female committee members participated in 54 training hours over 17 days. The training focused more on the knowledge rather than skills as the training time was limited and the sessions take more the shape of induction sessions for the topics of Gender GBV community participation and leadership. Pre and post tests and evaluation forms were used on a sample of the trainees groups. The results showed improvement in the knowledge among participants about Gender GBV women leadership and women community participation. The post results showed that 16 of participants became know very well the concept of gender GBV and protection compared with only one participant in the pretest. Moreover all participants confirmed that they became well known and aware about women rights in community participation after they received the capacity building sessions.

title.narrative: of targeted farmers, members of community committee, and service providers operational team (disaggregated by sex) that show improved gender mainstreaming knowledge, attitude and practices towards women empowerment in water resource management

description.narrative: of targeted farmers, members of community committee, and service providers operational team (disaggregated by sex) that show improved gender mainstreaming knowledge, attitude and practices towards women empowerment in water resource management

comment.narrative: Fully met 247 farmers 120 M 127 F showed improvement by 88.23 In March 2022 Oxfam hired external consultant to conduct training on mainstreaming gender in water resource management RTWWR and climate change with the committee members. 240 participants Female and Male from the community committees AlFukhari East Khan Younis and 7 Female committee members participated in 54 training hours over 17 days. The training focused more on the knowledge rather than skills as the training time was limited and the sessions take more the shape of induction sessions for the topics of Gender GBV community participation and leadership. Pre and post tests and evaluation forms were used on a sample of the trainees groups. The results showed improvement in the knowledge among participants about Gender GBV women leadership and women community participation. The post results showed that 16 of participants became know very well the concept of gender GBV and protection compared with only one participant in the pretest. Moreover all participants confirmed that they became well known and aware about women rights in community participation after they received the capacity building sessions.
